text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, Grass Wonder and I sit
down to unwind after the day's
training
session.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today, Trainer. I found some
good tea, so I'd like to
make you a cup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, while I understand the need to
recover after my last race, it
seems a
shame to shorten our training sessions to
this extent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For the past few days,
we've been finishing
before the sun even goes
down...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know that, of course. I'll need a
well-rested body to win...
Right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The last drop makes the cup run over," as
they say. I am always
grateful for your kind
consideration. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, dong...

text_block_list.name: School PA
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder, please report to the
student council president's office.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, what could that be about?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was asked to participate in a scrimmage
for the upcoming school
orientation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It will be quite an honor to show my
racing
to new students who hope
to one day run
in the Twinkle Series. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should start training immediately—oh? Is
that a look of concern on
your face?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. I was swept up in the
excitement of being selected
for the race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I will limit myself to some light
running in preparation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please don't trouble yourself to
accompany me. I'll be fine controlling
my
own pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says she'll keep her running under
control, but this is the same
racer who
turned down offers until she was perfectly
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once she decides to win,
even if it's just a
scrimmage, she'll tackle the
challenge with
everything she has... I should keep an eye
on her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Three more laps... But faster this
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough,
I see her training as if there's
a big race coming up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I know how she feels about winning, so
I keep my distance,
watching just to make
sure she doesn't go overboard.

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Such incredible speed! Grass Wonder
makes a huge final sprint!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And across the line! Grass Wonder takes
first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's win is overwhelming. As
soon as the race is over, the
young
students begin to gather around her.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Heeey! That was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You look real nice, but inside you're a
beast! You're super cool!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, what a privilege to be called a
beast. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Do I have something on my
face?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I really hope you race in the Twinkle
Series! You gotta win, beast
lady!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry—I won't fail. And when you're
older, we can all race
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From today's scrimmage, I can see that
Grass wants to win more than
ever. And I'll
be supporting her every step of the way.
